sourceCatalog.scope: Identity and source reading are separate. Prior source assessments retain their recorded depth; fresh coordinator reading is named only on the three explicitly rechecked papers. Raw abstracts and primary text remain private.

freshCoordinatorChecks: DeStefanis: full raw abstract and targeted Results/Methods; patient-derived organoid baseline-size finding corrected.
Dijkstra: full raw abstract and targeted MMRd/MHC-I results, killing assay and banking Methods.
Restivo 2022: full raw abstract and targeted matched fresh/slow-frozen CRC Results/Methods, two stage-IV patients; no universal recovery or clinical-equivalence promise.
NCI official raw glossary API: three complete definitions and dictionary/audience/language/term identity checked.
inheritedReadingLimits: NIH Assay Guidance Manual NBK144065: challenge/access page; full chapter not read. Official Promega ATP technical bulletin and Hafner supply the adopted interpretation.
Janeway NBK27163: access/challenge page; no full chapter credit. Macdonald primary raw abstract supports the bounded HLA allorecognition mechanism.
Voabil full article not read here: resident T-cell reactivation/clinical-response association restricted to verified raw abstract.
Yang 2026 humanized immune-stroma PDX restricted to abstract; no general conventional-PDX immune claim.
Fraser protocol full-article scope remains as recorded previously; mitochondrial/BAX/BAK and peptide interpretation supported by accessible Ryan/Butterworth targeted text.
elicit: No callable live Elicit tool in these batches; no question/report or JSON response is invented. Frozen discovery remains distinct from verified claims.
scope: Other primary assessments retain their recorded abstract or targeted-passage depth. Raw bodies and short source quotations stay private; no new whole-document reading or expert sign-off.
